summary: Craze & Crash, Friday demand night: added 3 Short topics (Lipton and Levi's founder stories, LEGO's 2003 loss and comeback now that DKK works), added Balaji vs Lay's (7.6M) as the business-war format's top example, and strengthened the no-figure title challenger.
why: core_needed was true (founder_bet) and both founder topics have breakout demand on their own idea (245K and 169K views on a 19.9K-subscriber channel). Titles without a figure now hold about 56% stayed to watch against about 27% for figure-led ones (n=4 a side).

findings.title: The niche's biggest on-niche Shorts are business wars
findings.detail: Balaji Wafers beat Lay's 7.6M views (141x), Chik beat HUL 4.4M. Our two best Shorts by stayed to watch (57.8%) are two-brand stories too.

findings.title: Titles without a figure hold twice as many viewers
findings.detail: n=4 a side: about 56% vs 27% stayed to watch; doc-title-no-figure moved up the first-second list.

findings.title: Levi Strauss FY2025 net revenues $6,282M
findings.detail: The payoff for the $68 rivet patent founder Short.

findings.title: LEGO 2025 revenue DKK 83.5B, net profit DKK 16.7B

findings.title: No recent event worth a long video
